Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
s921...@arcadia.cs.rmit.EDU.AU (Mark Timothy Heath) writes:

>I'd like to know what clan alignment are allies.

Non-vampire aliies have no clan. Similarily Caitiff have no clan.

>heres a scenerio.

>I play Consanguineous boon (or comdemnation)

>which mentions `member of that clan he or she controls.'

>I choose to TAP all Malkavian (sp?) I think it was a Consag. condemnation
>card.

>Is the Muddled Vampire Hunter Malkavian? Since He has the Malkavian
>symbol on the side of his card.
>Does he get tapped? Can a Methuselah gain one blood of Consag. Boon is
>played?

Definitely not. You need a Malk to gain control of the Hunter, but he's
just Kine, not Kindred.
Similarily, You could not tap (or get pool for having) any Caitiff, as
"Caitiff" is a state of clanlessness, not a clan.

Messages.Body:

The Malkavian symbol on Muddles the Vamp. Hunter means that he is the sort
of ally that would be recruited for you by one of your Malkavian minions, so
therefore you must have a Malk. on the table in your controled region who is
able to recruit him. (One has difficulty seeing a Ventrue doing this.)

Only vampires are members of clans, so you only take them into consideration
when figuring out the effects of the cards you mentioned.
